features.gapFinder_desc: Struggling with Class 9 Quadratic Equations? LearnLens traverses your learning graph to diagnose if your real block is Class 8 Factoring.

features.studyPlanner_desc: Plug in your free hours and upcoming exam date. LearnLens maps out 25-30 minute focused sessions tackling root prerequisites first.
features.aiTutor_desc: Powered by Gemini with strict offline fallbacks. Get personalized explanations for mistakes without hallucination risks.
